title: Validate a planning PNG
responsibility: Decode a complete PNG and return its dimensions within image size limits.

inputs.name: planImageCodec.bytes
inputs.description: PNG byte data supplied when a caller needs to decode a planning image. The Uint8Array must contain 33 to 33,554,432 bytes inclusive, encode positive dimensions with a product no greater than 32,000,000 pixels, and pass CRC-checked PNG decoding.

outputs.name: planImageCodec
outputs.description: The decoded PNG width and height returned after the encoded dimensions pass their limits and CRC-checked decoding succeeds. Both dimensions are positive and their product is no greater than 32,000,000 pixels.

errors.name: PlanningFailure
errors.description: Raised as invalid-image when bytes are not a Uint8Array, contain fewer than 33 bytes or more than 32 MiB, encode zero dimensions or more than 32,000,000 pixels, or fail CRC-checked PNG decoding.
